# International Journal of Applied Research (IJAR)

> > A monthly peer-reviewed, open-access multidisciplinary research journal indexed in Google Scholar, Crossref, ISSN, CODEN, and NISCAIR with a Total Citation Rate (TCR) of 4.11.

The International Journal of Applied Research (IJAR) is published by RJIF and led by Dr. A. C. Lal Kumar. It accepts manuscripts across all disciplines with a 15-25 day acceptance timeline and follows double-blind peer review processes in accordance with international publication ethics standards.

## Getting Started

- [Multidisciplinary Journal | International Journal of Applied Research](https://www.allresearchjournal.com): IJAR homepage: monthly peer-reviewed open-access multidisciplinary journal
- [About Us](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/about): Peer-reviewed journal indexed in NISCAIR, IndexCopernicus, Google Scholar
- [Invitation To Publish Articles](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/invitation): Call for papers with 15-25 day acceptance notification timeline
- [Editorial Board](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/board): Editorial board members including Dr. A. C. Lal Kumar and team

## Manuscript Submission & Publishing

- [Manuscript Submission](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/submission): Submit research manuscripts to ISSN/CODEN indexed multidisciplinary journal
- [Instructions to Author](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/instructions): Manuscript submission guidelines and formatting requirements for authors
- [Publication Charges](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/charges): Article processing charges with ICICI/IDBI Bank payment options
- [Editorial Policies](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/editorial-policies): Double-blind peer review process and manuscript submission procedures
- [Instructions to Reviewer](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/instructions-to-reviewer): Guidelines for peer review criteria and manuscript evaluation process

## Journal Metrics & Indexing

- [Total Citation Rate](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/total-citation-rate-multidisciplinary-journal): TCR metrics: 4.11 (Google Scholar) and 13 (Crossref) impact factor
- [Subscription of Multidisciplinary Journal | Buy Academic Journal Subscription](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/multidisciplinary-journal-subscription): Subscription options for individuals and libraries via AkiNik Publications
- [Biochemistry Journal](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/biochemistry-journal): International Journal of Advanced Biochemistry Research section

## Services & Support

- [Publication Certificate](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/certificate): Publication certificate service for main authors post-publication
- [Apply for Board Member](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/ApplyforBoardMember): Application form for editorial board membership positions
- [Archives](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/archives): Archive of past journal volumes and issues since 2014

## Optional

- [Journal's Publication Ethics and Malpractice Statement](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/Publication_Ethics_Malpractice_Statement): Ethics statement covering author, reviewer, and editor responsibilities
- [Informed Consent, Privacy and Confidentiality Statement](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/informed-consent): Privacy policy adapted from ICMJE ethical research guidelines
- [Statement for Human and Animal Right Ethics](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/human-and-animal-rights): Ethics statement following Declaration of Helsinki for research subjects
- [Conflict of Interest Statement](https://www.allresearchjournal.com/conflict-of-interest): Author and reviewer conflict of interest declaration requirements
